answer: Work waits on the onyx until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the pulse of the next round. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, reset on any identity-link attempt, no identity may audit its own recruit. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the vine of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
